name: Proposal for a decision
title: SECOND REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text:
The European Parliament refuses to approve how the Council spent its 2023 budget. It says the Council has refused for years to answer Parliament's questions or attend hearings, so Parliament cannot check the spending properly. Parliament asks the Council to cooperate, to split the European Council and Council budgets, and to resume talks at the highest level. This is a political decision and set of demands, not a change in the law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament withholds approval of the Council's 2023 spending and repeats its demands.
- **Who it affects:** The Council, its Secretary-General, and European Union taxpayers.
- **What happens next:** The Council is asked to resume talks with Parliament to end the deadlock.
